description: Defines classes and methods for managing asynchronous in-flight I/O operations in disk cache, including BackgroundIO and InFlightIO classes with thread synchronization and callback handling.

classes.name: BackgroundIO
classes.description: Represents a single asynchronous IO operation with thread-safe reference counting, supporting signaling, cancellation, and controller notification.

classes.name: InFlightIO
classes.description: Manages multiple asynchronous IO operations, providing mechanisms to wait for completion, drop pending operations, and handle operation callbacks.

methods.name: BackgroundIO::OnIOSignalled
methods.description: Signals that the IO operation has completed, notifying the controller.

methods.name: BackgroundIO::Cancel
methods.description: Allows cancellation of the IO task notification to the controller.

methods.name: InFlightIO::WaitForPendingIO
methods.description: Blocks until all tracked IO operations are complete.

methods.name: InFlightIO::DropPendingIO
methods.description: Drops all pending IO operations without waiting for their completion.

methods.name: InFlightIO::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an IO operation.

methods.name: InFlightIO::InvokeCallback
methods.description: Invokes the user callback after IO completion, with optional task cancellation.
